noVault.title: Passwords are saved without a password vault
noVault.detail: This computer has no password vault (keyring), so Studio saves your database passwords in a file only your user account can read. Anyone who can use your account could read them. To keep them in a vault, install one, such as GNOME Keyring, and restart Studio.
